name: victor-wambua/daraja-php
description: A strictly-typed, framework-agnostic PHP client for Safaricom's M-Pesa Daraja API, with a built-in mock Daraja server and callback safety helpers.

suggest.ext-curl: Needed by the bundled CurlClient (the default PSR-18 client) and by the mock server's callback delivery.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Needed by PdoIdempotencyStore (SQLite) and by the mock server.
suggest.ext-openssl: Needed by SecurityCredential to encrypt the initiator password for B2C, Transaction Status and Reversal.
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Any PSR-18 client works in place of the bundled CurlClient.
